messages.subject: Model of the Week*
parts:
Stan Users:

We’re excited about the success of Stan, but we don’t always get to hear
about those success stories.  To that end we are inviting you to share your
success stories with us and the Stan community.

If you’ve built something awesome in Stan then send us an email at
m...@mc-stan.org with a description of your model and the story of how it 
was built, tested, and optimized — code and pseudo-data that others can 
run is highly encouraged!  Once a week* we’ll choose a story and share it on
Andrew’s blog along with some commentary from the devs.

The Stan Development Team

*Exact frequency subject to change.
